item.title: Stephen “Steve” Kaufman (1941 – 2026)
item.description: (Member Of Bryan AmVets & Bryan Moose) Stephen “Steve” Louis Kaufman, age 84, of Bryan, passed away Saturday, January 3, 2026, at Majestic Care of Bryan. Steve was owner and operator of Kaufman’s Bar and Restaurant in Napoleon, Ohio. He also worked at Sauder Woodworking for 25 years.
